notes.title: Small Demo Update
notes.notes:
Hello Hatchers! 🐣
I’ve got a small update for you.
After showcasing the game at Gamescom, I noticed that some of you had trouble finding your way around and discovering all the features. To make things clearer, I’ve prepared a little update for the demo with the following improvements:

The cuckoo will now guide you through the map once, explaining the most important elements.

You can now reset the tutorial at any time from the menu.

Fixed a bug where not all Egglings were displayed when released.

Thanks for playing, and I’m looking forward to your feedback!
